name: index-month-start-flow
why: The index-ETF specialty has nine barren agents and three losing traders; recent overnight and rotation replays also lost money despite mechanical passes. Test the distinct published month-start cash-flow hypothesis with one fractional SPY exposure, capped at $2 and further constrained by cash and House limits. Enter on the first observed trading session of a month and target the third session's late afternoon, using completed daily bars rather than an assumed holiday calendar. This is an untested calendar hypothesis, not measured league alpha or a claimed repair of the existing agents. Start at rung 0, preserve applicable selection history, reject insufficient samples rather than forcing turnover, and require after-cost replay, applicable holdout, independent paper, audit and capital qualification.
